scope: one temporal motif window under independent within-frame categorical site permutation
surrogate: within each selected training and test prefix, independently Fisher-Yates shuffle positions preserving frame shape and exact label counts; leave the split, guard, and frame boundaries fixed
pipeline: rerun the temporal training gate and refit the motif and Huffman comparator for each draw; score the same held-out frames with models frozen within each draw
statistic: positive part of model-charged motif gain, or zero on a completed split with no training motif; retain signed raw gains and missing draws
rank: (1 + count of valid draws at least as extreme as observed) / (B + 1), ties included; choose seed and 1–199 draws before scoring; no rank after any failed draw and no retries
verification: independent deterministic shuffle and score replay, known planted and absent cases, histogram invariance, budget failure handling, and installed conformance
limits: engineering check for the product of within-frame permutations; inference requires joint invariance under that group, and no population, false-positive, or structural-score calibration is admitted
